posts.title: Coding Has Become a Form of Magic
posts.description: If you’re a Millennial like me, you grew up with Harry Potter and, at some point, likely wished that magic was real. As a teenager, you may even have tried uttering a spell in secret, concentrating as hard as you could, just to see whether anything would happen. posts.title: Quoting Thorsten Ball
posts.description: I think slop is not [everything made with] AI, it’s the absence of taste. It’s the absence of having a quality bar . It’s the absence of knowing what you want . — Thorsten Ball , Thorsten Ball, on the podcast Raising an Agent, Season 2, Episode 2. Tags: ai , podcast , coding-agents
